headword: {年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}
gloss: open year-round; no holidays; 365 days a year

definitions.gloss: open year-round; no holidays; 365 days a year
definitions.explanation: Describes a business or facility that operates every day of the year without regular closing days. Very commonly seen on signs at shops, restaurants, and convenience stores.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}です。
{年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We are open every day of the year.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧24⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: Convenience stores are open year-round, 24 hours a day, so they're convenient.

notes:
A four-character compound meaning literally 'year-through no-rest': ⟦{年中|ねんじゅう}→年中：00311_nenjuu⟧ (throughout the year) + ⟦{無休|むきゅう}→無休：10998_mukyuu⟧ (no holidays/rest). Extremely common on shop signs and business information in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧: open for business year-round
- {年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}・24⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧: open 365 days, 24 hours

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{定休日|ていきゅうび}→定休日：09541_teikyuubi⟧: regular closing day — the opposite concept
- ⟦{無休|むきゅう}→無休：10998_mukyuu⟧: no holidays/days off
- ⟦{年中|ねんじゅう}→年中：00311_nenjuu⟧: throughout the year; all year long

CULTURAL NOTE:
This phrase is ubiquitous in Japan, where many convenience stores, family restaurants, and chain businesses operate every day of the year. It is often displayed prominently on storefronts.
